Review blocked: do not map TWSE/TPEX/TAIFEX to Market.HKFE in services/execution/lean_runtime/symbol_parser.py. The live LEAN executor resolves ParsedSymbol.lean_market into Symbol.Create(..., Market.<Y>) and will misclassify Taiwan instruments as Hong Kong. Remove the parser extension or add a real Taiwan/custom-market path, then rerun targeted verification.
